tools.name: draft_chat_message
tools.description: Places text in the NanoGPT composer without sending it or starting a paid request. By default it refuses to replace an existing draft.

text.description: Message text to place in the NanoGPT composer.

replace_existing.description: Set true only when the user asked to replace the current draft.

tools.name: find_text_models
tools.description: Searches NanoGPT's public text-model catalog by model ID. Returns up to eight matching model IDs and does not change chat state.

query.description: Part of a model ID, such as claude, gemini, or glm.

limit.description: Maximum results to return, from 1 to 8.

tools.name: get_chat_state
tools.description: Returns the current NanoGPT chat mode, selected model, and whether the composer contains a draft. It does not return conversation or draft text.
